title: Morning Sickness
summary: Learn why morning sickness happens and practical ways to reduce nausea during pregnancy.
content: Morning sickness is common in early pregnancy and can be managed through hydration, small frequent meals, gentle activity, and support from your healthcare provider.

title: First Trimester Nutrition
summary: Key nutrients and meal ideas for the first trimester to support your baby’s early development.
content: A balanced first trimester diet includes lean protein, whole grains, fruits, vegetables, and prenatal vitamins. Focus on iron, folate, calcium, and hydration for a healthy pregnancy start.

title: Safe Pregnancy Exercises
summary: Gentle moves and stretching routines that support strength, flexibility, and comfort throughout pregnancy.
content: Safe exercises during pregnancy include walking, swimming, prenatal yoga, and pelvic floor training. Listen to your body and check with a care provider before starting any new routine.

title: Baby Development Week by Week
summary: Track how your baby grows during each trimester and learn the milestones to expect along the way.
content: From heartbeat development to movement and growth, each week of pregnancy brings new changes. This guide helps you understand your baby’s progress and what to expect at each milestone.

title: Staying Hydrated During Pregnancy
summary: Hydration tips to help maintain energy, support circulation, and reduce pregnancy discomfort.
content: Proper hydration supports blood volume, digestion, and temperature regulation. Drink water throughout the day, add fruit-infused water, and choose hydrating snacks like watermelon and cucumbers.

title: Managing Pregnancy Fatigue
summary: Easy strategies to boost your energy and rest well while your body adjusts to pregnancy.
content: Pregnancy fatigue is normal, especially in the first trimester. Prioritize sleep, eat balanced meals, stay active with gentle movement, and accept help from friends and family.

title: Preparing for Labor
summary: A step-by-step preparation guide to help you feel ready for labor and birth.
content: Labor preparation includes building a birth plan, attending antenatal classes, packing your hospital bag, and practicing breathing and comfort techniques.

title: Hospital Bag Checklist
summary: A practical checklist of what to pack for you, your baby, and your birth partner.
content: Include essentials like comfortable clothing, toiletries, important documents, baby clothes, feeding supplies, and personal comfort items to make your hospital stay easier.

title: Signs of Labor
summary: Learn the common early labor signs and when to contact your healthcare provider.
content: Watch for contractions, water breaking, pelvic pressure, and changes in vaginal discharge. Knowing the signs helps you make timely decisions and feel more confident.

title: Breastfeeding Basics
summary: Start breastfeeding with essential positioning, latch tips, and feeding frequency guidance.
content: Breastfeeding begins with skin-to-skin contact, proper latch, and frequent feeding. Learn to recognize hunger cues and how to manage common challenges with supportive techniques.

title: Postpartum Recovery
summary: Care tips for physical recovery, rest, and gentle movement after birth.
content: Postpartum recovery includes rest, pelvic floor exercises, wound care, and monitoring emotional wellbeing. Accept help and create a supportive care plan for the first weeks.

title: Newborn Care Essentials
summary: Practical newborn care skills for feeding, sleeping, diapering, and gentle soothing.
content: Newborn care basics include safe sleep, feeding support, bathing, and understanding newborn cues. Build confidence with simple routines and trusted health guidance.

title: Mental Wellness During Pregnancy
summary: Self-care practices to support emotional balance, stress reduction, and resilience during pregnancy.
content: Mental wellness during pregnancy includes relaxation, social support, mindful breathing, and checking in with a care provider if you feel overwhelmed.

title: Foods to Avoid During Pregnancy
summary: A clear guide to foods and drinks to avoid for a safer, healthier pregnancy.
content: Avoid unpasteurized dairy, raw meats, high-mercury fish, and excessive caffeine during pregnancy. Choose nourishing alternatives and follow food safety best practices.

title: Importance of Antenatal Care
summary: Why regular antenatal visits matter and what screening tests you can expect.
content: Antenatal care helps monitor your health, track fetal growth, identify risks early, and provide education on pregnancy and birth planning.
